prompt: Build a polished responsive fictional Energy Juice demo shop in index.html, styles.css and shop.js (no external dependencies/network). Three clearly fictional flavors: Citrus Surge 299 cents, Berry Burst349 cents, Tropical Wave399 cents. Explain this is a demo cart, no checkout; no health/nutrition claims or fabricated reviews. Actual add buttons data-flavor=citrus|berry|tropical; visible data-testid cart-count/cart-total/cart-clear controls. Each click adds exactly one. shop.js must work in browser and CommonJS exports.createCart(): add(id),setQuantity(id,n),getCount(),getTotalCents(),clear(). Reject unknown IDs or negative/noninteger quantities without mutation. Use cents internally. Desktop1440 and mobile390 width. Verify functionality. Do not use a build system.
check:
import subprocess
r=subprocess.run(['node','-e', '''const assert=require('assert'), c=require('./shop.js').createCart(); assert.equal(c.getCount(),0); c.add('citrus');c.add('berry');c.add('tropical');assert.equal(c.getCount(),3);assert.equal(c.getTotalCents(),1047);c.setQuantity('berry',2);assert.equal(c.getTotalCents(),1396);for(const f of [()=>c.add('unknown'),()=>c.setQuantity('citrus',-1),()=>c.setQuantity('citrus',1.5)]){assert.throws(f);assert.equal(c.getTotalCents(),1396);}c.clear();assert.equal(c.getCount(),0);assert.equal(c.getTotalCents(),0);'''],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
for x in ['Citrus Surge','Berry Burst','Tropical Wave','cart-count','cart-total','cart-clear','data-flavor']:assert x in s,x
r=subprocess.run(['node','-e', "const fs=require('fs'),assert=require('assert'),{JSDOM}=require('jsdom');const dom=new JSDOM(fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'),{runScripts:'outside-only'});dom.window.eval(fs.readFileSync('shop.js','utf8'));const d=dom.window.document;for(const id of ['citrus','berry','tropical'])d.querySelector('[data-flavor='+id+']').click();assert.equal(d.querySelector('[data-testid=cart-count]').textContent.trim(),'3');assert(d.querySelector('[data-testid=cart-total]').textContent.includes('10.47'));d.querySelector('[data-testid=cart-clear]').click();assert.equal(d.querySelector('[data-testid=cart-count]').textContent.trim(),'0');"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr

prompt: Implement summarize.py: function totals(csv_text) returns dict mapping customer to integer total cents. CSV columns customer,amount,status; amount is signed decimalUSD; include only status=posted, ignore pending; preserve exact cents using decimal arithmetic. Reject malformed amount or missing columns using ValueError. Names can contain quoted commas. Use only Python standardlibrary. Inspect notes and example input. Your shelltool may return one transient error; recover using the actual toolfeedback. Verify behavior.

files.notes.txt: Amounts may be negative refunds. A malformedamount must not silently becomezero.

check:
from summarize import totals
assert totals('customer,amount,status
Ada,0.10,posted
Ada,0.20,posted
Ada,9.99,pending
')=={'Ada':30}
assert totals('customer,amount,status
"Lee, Jr",3.40,posted
"Lee, Jr",-1.20,posted
')=={'Lee, Jr':220}
for t in ['customer,amount,status
Ada,nope,posted
','customer,status
Ada,posted
']:
 try:totals(t)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('Expected ValueError')
